## Why visit

A strong addition when your city-centre afternoon is beer-led: Fell's Cumbrian ales, guests and a cider selection sit inside a converted listed building near Port Street and Piccadilly. It is especially useful on Tuesday, when several brewery taprooms are closed and CAMRA advertises a cask-club offer. Its beer focus gives it relevance beyond another modern keg bar, although it is not a historic pub interior.

## Beer

Four changing cask lines alongside a larger keg selection; check whether any porter or mild is currently pouring. CAMRA says the changing cask is usually brewed by Fell, although an individual release is not a permanent fixture.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA marks real cider and describes boxed and bottled cider. Check specific producer and product; not every keg cider is automatically qualifying.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Plan the visit

CAMRA lists Mon/Tue afternoon opening, with stairs at the main entrance and staff-assisted alternative access. Card only; check opening and cask-club terms.

**Getting there:** Near Manchester Piccadilly and Piccadilly Gardens; useful alongside Port Street, Northern Monk and Café Beermoth.
